description:
Detect password spraying against RDP, SSH, VPN, OWA

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_initial_access_initial_access_135", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%external%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%remote%') AND "value" > 0
